description: This file implements the NetworkQualitiesPrefsManager class, which manages network quality preferences, including caching network quality data, initializing preferences, and handling updates within the Chromium networking component.

classes.name: NetworkQualitiesPrefsManager
classes.description: Manages network quality preferences, including caching, updating, and notifying the network quality estimator.

methods.name: NetworkQualitiesPrefsManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the preferences manager with a delegate.

methods.name: ~NetworkQualitiesPrefsManager
methods.description: Destructor that performs cleanup and removes observers.

methods.name: InitializeOnNetworkThread
methods.description: Initializes the manager on the network thread, setting up the network quality estimator and reading preferences.

methods.name: ShutdownOnPrefSequence
methods.description: Shuts down the preferences delegate on the preference sequence.

methods.name: ClearPrefs
methods.description: Clears all cached preferences and updates the delegate.

methods.name: OnChangeInCachedNetworkQuality
methods.description: Handles updates to cached network quality data, maintaining cache size, and notifying the delegate.

methods.name: ForceReadPrefsForTesting
methods.description: Returns current preferences for testing purposes.
